cli.discovery: Read nodePath, cliPath and versionCommand from the local Codex Praetor configuration; never commit account or path details.

mappings.provider_semantics: Use the verified ACP filesystem client proxy for a bounded audit inside the declared worktree.
Use ACP filesystem plus the exact declared terminal-check proxy; Edit and Write remain unavailable.
Use ACP filesystem proxy writes only inside the declared disposable worker worktree.

lifecycle.launch: invoke-codex-praetor.ps1 starts the Node ACP runner with a fixed model; the runner speaks JSON-RPC NDJSON to CodeBuddy and owns filesystem and bounded terminal client proxies.
lifecycle.parse_terminal_state: watch-codex-praetor-job.ps1 requires CodeBuddy ACP terminal evidence, separates a clean process exit from a usable worker result, and records structured session updates without retaining chain-of-thought text.
lifecycle.cleanup: session/cancel is sent through ACP; Codex cold recovery creates a new ACP session from durable ledger state. Controlled retention later reclaims disposable worktrees.

evidence.end_to_end: A current-generation provider canary in an isolated worktree is required before real dispatch.
